Chapter 7102: World Reborn

Chapter 7102: World Reborn

Core of Order was hidden in Ruin, a riddle impossible to understand. Celestial immortals couldn’t glimpse into its existence.

It was a type of maternal power, something foreign to immortals in Heavenrealm. It exceeded their imagination and understanding.

The broken affinities and karma in Ruin became whole again. The past and the present flowed as once, allowing time to surge toward the future.

Shattered spaces linked together by the weaving of rules and order. The utterly destroyed areas fused into the new space, rebuilding a complete expanse.

Space was essential, forming the framework of everything. Time and space then intersected and merged, allowing karma and other affinities to prosper...

The reconstructing order drew the tribulations, incorporating them into the new framework as seams and welding points, binding everything firmly.

The new powers suddenly condensed into a single point, forming the purest worldly essences.

“Boom!” The final destination shook Heavenrealm in full, making all worlds feel like lost boats amidst the storm.

“What’s going on?!” Immortals became frightened.

“Is it the calamity?” Some were scared out of their mind.

They were stricken with anxiety after the news of the inevitable calamity. Any development easily frightened them.

“Boom!” Chaos erupted from Ruin upon the full reconstruction. The sky had stars again; continents rose to the surface. It didn’t take long before the karmic forces allowed life to appear.

Immortals could sense a new life force coming from Ruin.

“A new world...” A hidden immortal said.

“How can this be?” They couldn’t believe it because the calamity signaled the end. How could there be a new world?

Some became curious enough to leave their caves. What they saw shocked them.

“Isn’t that Ruin?” One of them observed the new world.

“A major world? I thought it would be a minor one.” Someone blurted.

“A minor world can’t have such powerful life forces.” Another said.

“But a major world, that’s heaven-defying.” One immortal spoke.

“Don’t forget, Stygian became a new world as well.” A primordial immortal reminded them.

This reminded everyone that something had happened to the fallen world. However, Guardian Alliance had built a wall around Stygian, preventing the life force from leaking out to Heavenrealm.

“Stygian and then Ruin, that’s the return of two worlds. The nine are here again.” Someone became excited.

After all, many immortals came from these two worlds. They were more than happy to see their home again.

“Who can do this in such a short time?” A golden immortal asked.

“Li Qiye, only Li Qiye.” A primordial immortal answered confidently.

“What realm is he in? How can he be so powerful? This is beyond what any immortal can do.” Another sentimentally said.

Normally, Heavenfall and Dusk were considered the strongest. Those who knew more had higher respect for Hidden Immortal, Octopus, and An Ran. Alas, even these three couldn’t recreate two major worlds.

“Maybe he can stop the calamity and save our world.” Someone had a strange thought.

“No one can stop the calamity.” Another immediately dispelled this idea.
